bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur protested on the road at midnight due to continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.
A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal by November 1, and the district team should watch weather warnings.
Damaged concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Tiruvallur put the public at risk, and the office should coordinate repairs with the Highways department.
Cisco President Jeetu Patel supports giving Gen Z unlimited AI tools to accelerate development, and the portfolio team should note this industry trend.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman questioned PC RAM usage amid DRAM shortages, and the office should watch hardware impacts on software development.
